<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="gPr_p7MAJPrMGs_Q347b" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="5067" dy="3553" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '20px'}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Client
 participant Svc as Auth Service
 participant RL as rateLimiter<br/>(middleware)
 participant Redis as Redis
 participant Prisma as Prisma
 participant DB as PostgreSQL

 C->>+Svc: POST /v1/auth/refresh<br/>Cookie: refreshToken

 Note over Svc: verifyRefreshToken()<br/>checks signature only —<br/>no DB call yet
 Svc->>Svc: decode JWT payload

 alt signature invalid or expired
 Svc-->>C: 401 Invalid or expired refresh token
 else signature valid — userId known
 Svc->>+RL: rate limit check<br/>identifyBy: userId
 RL->>+Redis: INCR rl:refresh:per-minute:user:<userId>
 Note over RL,Redis: Lua script — atomic<br/>INCR + EXPIRE
 Redis-->>-RL: count
 RL-->>-Svc: ok

 alt over 20/min
 Svc-->>C: 429 Too Many Requests<br/>Retry-After: <ttl>
 else within limits
 Svc->>+Prisma: refreshToken.findUnique({ tokenHash })
 Prisma->>+DB: SELECT revoked, expires_at<br/>FROM auth.refresh_tokens<br/>WHERE token_hash = $1
 DB-->>-Prisma: { revoked, expires_at }
 Prisma-->>-Svc: { revoked, expires_at }

 alt revoked or expired
 Svc-->>C: 401 Refresh token is no longer valid
 else token still valid
 Svc->>+Prisma: refreshToken.update({ tokenHash }, { revoked: true })
 Note over Svc,Prisma: rotation — old token<br/>can never be replayed
 Prisma->>+DB: UPDATE auth.refresh_tokens<br/>SET revoked = TRUE<br/>WHERE token_hash = $1
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc->>+Prisma: user.findUnique({ userId })
 Prisma->>+DB: SELECT user_id, role<br/>FROM auth.users<br/>WHERE user_id = $1
 DB-->>-Prisma: user row
 Prisma-->>-Svc: user

 alt user no longer exists
 Svc-->>C: 401 Account no longer exists
 else user exists
 Note over Svc: issueTokenPair()<br/>JWT signing — access + refresh
 Svc->>Svc: signAccessToken() / signRefreshToken()

 Svc->>+Prisma: refreshToken.create({ userId, tokenHash, expiresAt })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO auth.refresh_tokens (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc->>+Prisma: auditLog.create({ userId, event: 'user.token_refreshed' })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO auth.audit_logs (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc-->>-C: 200 OK<br/>{ accessToken }<br/>Set-Cookie: new refreshToken (HttpOnly, Secure)
 end
 end
 end
 end
",
